name: City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, March 21, 2017 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Mayor Waronek
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
- Declare April as DMV/Donate Life Month
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-o, be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Special Meetings of March 7, 2017 and the Regular Meeting of March 7, 2017.
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item # 7b
c.

ACTION: That the demands and payroll be received and filed.
Item # 7c
d.

ACTION: That the report be received and filed.

ACTION: That the report be received and filed.

f.

ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item # 7f
g.
Monthly Report for the Parks & Recreation Department
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item # 7g
h.
Monthly Report for the Public Works Department
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item # 7h
i.
January Treasurer Report
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item # 7i
j.
Adopt Ordinance No. 785
ORD 785 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF LOMITA AMENDING SECTIONS 2-9.02, 2-10.02, 2-12.02, AND 2-12-13.02 OF TITLE II (ADMINISTRATION) OF THE LOMITA MUNICIPAL CODE DELETING THE EIGHT (8) YEAR TERM LIMITS FOR CITY COMMISSIONERS AND BOARD MEMBERS AND SETTING THE EXPIRATION DATE FOR ALL TERMS OF COMMISSIONERS AND BOARD MEMBERS FOR JUNE 1ST OF YEAR APPLICABLE TO EACH COMMISSIONER OR BOARD MEMBER. (Second Reading)
ACTION: That City Council Adopt Ordinance No. 785
Item # 7j
k.
Approve Lease Agreement with the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Los Angeles for 250 acre-feet of unused FY 2016-17 groundwater pumping rights.
ACTION: That City Council authorize the City Manager to execute a Lease Agreement with the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Los Angeles for 250 acre-feet of unused FY 2016-17 groundwater pumping rights, at a price of $100.00 per acre-foot for a total of $25,000.
Item # 7k
l.
Award a Public Works Agreement to Stephen Doreck Equipment Rentals, Inc. for the Water Main Replacement on Reed Street and Forrester Drive
ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council:
1)
Approve the Plans and Specifications for the Water Main Replacement on Reed Street and Forrester Drive project; and
2)
Approve a budget amendment of $54,108 to be transferred from savings from the Water Meter Replacement Phase 2 for a total project budget of $119,108 including a 10% contingency; and
3)
Award a Public Works Agreement to Stephen Doreck Equipment Rentals, Inc. in the amount of $108,280 for the project; and
4)
Authorize the City Manager to execute the Public Works Agreement.
Item # 7l
m.
Authorize transfer of $15,000 from the Railroad Museum Foundation Trust Fund to the Railroad Museum Foundation General Maintenance Account for Purchase of new display cases and audio visual equipment
ACTION: The Railroad Museum Foundation Board is recommending the allocation of funds in the amount of $15,000 from the Railroad Museum Foundation Trust Fund to the Railroad Museum Foundation General Maintenance account (720-750-5705.000) to purchase new display cases and audio visual equipment for the Museum.
Item #7m
n.
Approval of Amendment No. 1 to the City Manager Employment Agreement
RES 2017-06 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA APPROVING AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO THE CITY MANAGER'S EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT.
ACTION: That the City Council approve Amendment No. 1 to the January 27, 2016 City Manager Employment Agreement and adopt said resolution approving the Amendment No. 1.
Item # 7n
o.
Consideration of Letters of Support for AB1 and SB1 related to Transportation funding.
ACTION: That the City Council authorize the Mayor to sign the attached support letters for AB1 and SB1.
Item # 7o
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
8.
SCHEDULE A DATE AND TIME FOR THE FY 2017-2018 BUDGET WORKSHOP AND FY 2017-2018 BUDGET PUBLIC HEARING
Presented by Administrative Services Kamada
ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council:
1)
Select one of the following dates for the FY 2017-2018 Budget Workshop:
a.
Monday, May 15, 2017 at 4:30 p.m.
b.
Tuesday, May 16, 2017 at 4:30 p.m.
c.
Thursday, May 18, 2017 at 4:30 p.m.
2)
Schedule the FY 2017-2018 Budget Public Hearing on Tuesday, June 20, 2017 at 6:30 p.m.
Item # 8
9.
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION ON A SKATEBOARD PARK AND/OR PORTABLE SKATEBOARDING EQUIPMENT FOR YOUTH
Presented by Parks & Recreation Director Harding
ACTION: That the Council provide direction to staff on whether to further pursue a youth oriented Skateboard Park and/or portable skateboard obstacles.
Item # 9
PUBLIC HEARING:
10.
PUBLIC HEARING - PROPOSED ORDINANCE RELATIVE TO THE ADOPTION OF REVISED TITLE 32 LOS ANGELES COUNTY FIRE CODE
Presented by Assistant City Manager Sugano
ORD NO. 786 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, ADOPTING REFERENCE TITLE 32- FIRE CODE OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY CODE AMENDING SECTION 3-1(FIRE PREVENTION) INCORPORATING THE 2016 EDITION OF THE CALIFORNIA FIRE CODE WITH CERTAIN CHANGES AND AMENDMENTS AND MAKING OTHER REVISIONS THERETO. (First Reading)
ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council:
1)
After the City Attorney reads the title of the ordinance, introduce on first reading an ordinance adopting by reference Title 32 - The 2017 Consolidated Fire Protection District of Los Angeles County Fire Code; and
2)
Direct staff to schedule the second reading and adoption of the ordinance for the April 4, 2017, City Council meeting; and
3)
File a copy of the ratification of the more restrictive building standards and required local findings together with the adopted City Ordinance with the State Department of Housing and Community Development.
Item # 10
11.
ADJOURNMENT That the City Council meeting be adjourned in memory of Jesse Esphorst, Jr. to the next a Regular Meeting on Tuesday, April 4, 2017, at 6:30 p.m., to be held in the Council Chambers, 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
11.
ADJOURNMENT That the City Council meeting be adjourned in memory of Jesse Esphorst, Jr. to the next a Regular Meeting on Tuesday, April 4, 2017, at 6:30 p.m., to be held in the Council Chambers, 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
